description: Understand the basics of the R language, including Introduction to R Language.
Understand how manipulate data with R programming language and implement fundamental programming tasks.

Learn and apply foundational SQL and R knowledge for accessing databases from Jupyter notebooks, including relational database reminders, intermediate SQL, database access with R, working with database objects, and SQL-with-R practice.
Know how to wrangle data for data analysis, develop models, improve models, evaluate and tune the performance.

Understand how to describe and build graphs using R packages. Implement various types of basic charts to visualize like bar charts, histograms, pie charts, scatter plots, line plots, and box plots, including Basic Plots, Maps, and Customization.
Implement a small data science project that includes data wrangling, data analysis, data visualization, model development, model evaluation, reporting, and presentation.
